create_visualizer_instance: create a Visualizer instance with opt and name to log training metrics via TensorFlow
log_images_to_tensorflow: log a dictionary of numpy images to TensorFlow summary with labels and step
log_scalars_to_tensorflow: log a dictionary of scalar metric values to TensorFlow summary with labels and step
print_current_scalars: print and append current epoch iteration scalars to a log file
initialize_visualizer_logging: initialize a Visualizer that creates a TensorFlow logger and training loss log file
